notes: Clinical Study to Evaluate Mavacamten in Adults With Symptomatic Obstructive HCM. Mavacamten: Improved symptoms (36.6% achieved primary composite endpoint vs 17.2%). Reduced LVOT gradient, improved exercise capacity. FDA approved 2022. NEJM.

Mavacamten for Symptomatic Obstructive HCM Eligible for Septal Reduction. Mavacamten: 65% avoided septal reduction vs 11% placebo. Improved symptoms, reduced gradient. Alternative to invasive therapy. Lancet.

Study Evaluating Aficamten in Symptomatic Obstructive HCM. Aficamten: Improved exercise capacity and symptoms (14.8% improved ≥1 NYHA vs 34.3% placebo worsened). Reduced LVOT gradient. Second myosin inhibitor. NEJM.
Symptomatic Relief in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy. Obstructive HCM. Disopyramide: Reduced LVOT gradient, improved symptoms (17.4% vs 38.1% worsened). Traditional antiarrhythmic for HCM. Eur Heart J.
Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy. High-risk HCM. ICD: Appropriate shocks 11% at 5yr, prevented SCD. Registry showing ICD benefit in high-risk HCM. JACC.

Alcohol Septal ablation vs Surgical myectomy for Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Obstructive HCM. Alcohol ablation: Similar symptom relief (12.2% vs 7.3% mortality/need for reintervention). Less invasive option. Circulation.

Transcatheter Septal Reduction in Hypertrophic Obstructive Cardiomyopathy. Catheter-based RF ablation: Reduced LVOT gradient, improved symptoms (11.1% vs 41.2% events). Novel less-invasive approach. JACC Cardiovasc Interv.
